note: Alternate codes for the same course. Reviewed data, not inference (ADR-0037). Each entry maps a canonical course id to the other codes that mean the same course. Two kinds appear: genuine cross-listings, where Duke's registrar and a Fuqua requirement document file one course under different subject prefixes, and spelling variants inside the documents themselves. Resolution is exact-code only; nothing is matched by similarity at runtime.

distinctFamilies.895: Fuqua Client Consulting Practicum. Every FCCP course is numbered 895 and the subject prefix is what distinguishes them. The source documents state directly that a Marketing 895 does not satisfy a requirement for Strategy 895. These must never be aliased to each other, however similar their titles look.
distinctFamilies.894: Special Topics. The number is reused for unrelated courses across and within subjects.
distinctFamilies.898: Special Topics and named seminars. HLTHMGMT 898 alone covers five different courses.
